articles.summary: ISELIN, N.J., Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Provident Financial Services, Inc. (NYSE: PFS) (the “Company”) reported net income of $69.2 million, or $0.53 per basic and diluted share for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $78.1 million, or $0.60 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and $71.7 million, or $0.55 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net income totaled $226.7 million, or $1.74 per basic and diluted share, compared to $207.7 million, or $1.59 per basic and diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Results for the quarter were impacted by a $17.5 million one-time loss on extinguishment of debt due to the accelerated amortization of purchase accounting adjustments, core conversion related costs of $3.7 million and $465,000 of branch restructuring expenses. articles.summary: ISELIN, NJ, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Provident Financial Services, Inc. (NYSE:PFS) (the “Company”) Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.24 per common share payable on November 27, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 13, 2026. About the Company Provident Financial Services, Inc. is the holding company for Provident Bank, a community-oriented bank offering "Commitment you can count on" since 1839. Provident Bank provides a comprehensive array of financial products and services through its network of branches throughout New Jersey, Bucks, Lehigh and Northampton counties in Pennsylvania, as well as Orange, Queens and Nassau Counties in New York. The Bank also provides fiduciary and wealth management services through its wholly owned subsidiary, Beacon Trust Company and insurance services through its wholly owned subsidiary, Provident Protection Plus, Inc.
